title: Document Command Dsl Op Store Architecture
description: Achieve the target app architecture: app defines document (entities, diff, two-way conversion documents↔packs), commands (binary protocol for communication and storage, two-way conversion dsl↔ops↔protocols), dsl (maximum token-efficient consistent textual representation of a document), op (maximum token-efficient consistent textual representation of a command) with operations that yield diffs and inverses composed from other operations. Apps use store for local-first in-memory state management with optional hot-swappable backbone. Identify all gaps, plan all mechanisms, and refactor end to end so a workforce of agents can execute it.
summary:
Mapped the full repo against the target app architecture (document/entities/diff/packs, commands/binary protocol, dsl, op/operations/inverse, store with hot-swappable backbone), wrote the binding gap register + mechanism designs + 10-wave workforce plan into the ticket folder, and landed the foundational mechanism waves (W0-W2 plus an M-F slice).

**Gap analysis (contract.md)**: five parallel read-only sweeps (store, protocol, dsl, pack, framework/apps) established that the document pillars are DONE and law-covered (39 typed DocumentApp projections, OperationDiff/backwards, DocumentDsl/DocumentPack with the pack≡dsl equivalence law, hot-swappable Backbone with store_sync actors), and the gaps concentrate in the command pillar: op payloads never binary (OpPayload.binary always None), causal/wire command payloads serde_json, DocumentCommand JSON-only with no text/binary form, backwards ops never persisted (undo dies across save/load), compile_ops/decompile_ops unwired into storage, plus kernel duplication (framework/core twins of protocol types, OS JSON-patch action kernel, missing JS handle-command bridge), snapshot inverses in some apps, no native backbone URI resolution, and a hygiene tail (24 gaps G1-G24, each with file:line anchors). Mechanisms M-A..M-H and waves W0-W10 (with per-wave gates and cross-wave laws) are specified for the agent workforce; conformance.md is the per-app W8 tracker.

**Implemented — W1 (op binary codec seam)**: pack_value gained container-less `encode_record_body`/`decode_record_body` (symbol table + fields, no header/manifest/footer, chunking structurally disabled; DecCtx refactored to a DecSource::{File,Inline} resolution enum), forwarded through the pack facade; protocol_command gained `trait OpBinary` (🔖️OpBinary region beside OpText, re-exported from the protocol facade); the runtime `op_rt` (layout `format u8 | variant ordinal varint | record body`, ordinal = DslVariants declaration order) lives in the dsl facade — NOT store, because the DslVariants bound makes a store-hosted twin a distinct trait instance inside dsl's own test build (hit in practice; documented on the module) — with store re-exporting `store::op_rt` for the one-facade rule; dsl gained regular pack+protocol deps (verified acyclic). store::test_support gained `assert_op_text_binary_equivalence` (decode_op(encode_op(op)) == parse_op(print_op(op)) == op + determinism).

**Implemented — W2 (derive flip)**: `#[derive(dsl::DslOps)]` now additionally emits `impl ::protocol::OpBinary` via `::dsl::op_rt` — every op enum fleet-wide gained the binary codec with zero app-source changes.

**Implemented — M-F slice (G14)**: store/sync/rs gained nx wiring (project.json + script.ts, @semio-tech/store-sync-rs, four test tiers — store_sync tests reachable via nx for the first time); launch.json gained 🧪️test🗃️store / 🧪️test🗃️store-sync entries and the broken 🧪️verify🔁️os-sync entry (still invoking the renamed semio-framework-sync crate) was fixed to store_sync.

**Verification**: cargo test green for pack_value (17, 4 new), pack, protocol_command (8, incl. OpBinary fixture), protocol, dsl (16, incl. derived-enum text≡binary law), store (72, incl. op_rt round-trip + malformed-input rejection); `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` exit 0 under the new derive emission; `bun nx run @semio-tech/store-rs:wasm` green (new dsl deps wasm-clean); `bun nx run @semio-tech/store-sync-rs:test` 19/19.

**Remaining waves for the workforce (specified in contract.md)**: W3 DocumentCommand text+binary grammar (delete dispatch_json), W4 persist backwards+cursor / storage flip to .pack+.spr, W5 causal+wire binary flip with TS twin + fixture regen, W6 kernel unification (framework/core twin deletion, OS JSON-patch kernel deletion, JS handle-command bridge), W7 backbone factory registry + store wasm surface, W8 per-app conformance fan-out (composed inverses, OpBinary law tests via the new assert), W9 protocol/pack hygiene, W10 full verification incl. runtime proof.
